card.name: Mitochondrial disease and gene wording
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation inside text about mitochondrial DNA, POLG mutations, or mitochondrial syndromes, such as a space after 'mitochondrially encoded', 'e.g.,' before Alpers syndrome, or 'and' in MELAS lists.

modes.label: Mitochondrial DNA variants
modes.description: Space or word right after 'mitochondrially encoded' before a gene name.

modes.label: POLG examples
modes.description: The 'e.g.,' that introduces Alpers-Huttenlocher syndrome after POLG mutations.
modes.example: mitochondrial DNA Polymerase γ (POLG) gene (e.g<<.,>> Alpers Huttenlocher Syndrome).

modes.label: Other stray cases
modes.description: Occasional words in other medical lists, like 'low-dose' aspirin or a drowning story.

card.plain: It lights up on small joining words in passages about mitochondrial gene mutations and syndromes.
